model.identity: Same GGUF the certified reference was produced from.

method: Fed the EXACT teacher-forced token ids the llama.cpp reference used (1, 185, 16, 15, ...) through the runtime-generated execution graph via the new --token-ids flag, dumped per-position argmax and logits via --dump-logits, and compared against the reference logits in RAWRXD_REFERENCE_REPRODUCIBILITY_001\ref_teacher_forced.

results.note: 0/20. The runtime graph is NOT in parity with llama.cpp on this model.

real_bugs_fixed_this_session: ResidualAdd published attn_proj, so it doubled the attention and dropped the block input entirely (logits were bit-identical across positions).
The MLA score dotted 192 dims across the no-rope/rope boundary instead of q_nope.k_nope + q_rope.k_rope.
RoPE inv_freq was indexed by element rather than by pair.

Publish(resid_in) ran after the attn RmsNorm, so the residual stream was a normalised vector; one dominating element then compounded through all 27 blocks (attn_norm L2 124 with a single 124 element, out_norm max 20.20). After the fix: attn_norm L2 35.38 max 5.74, out_norm L2 28.25 max 3.91.
what_parity_gate_was_passing_and_why_tha: The harness's [4] per-position parity compares GPU kernels against a CPU reference INSIDE the same executor. It reported cosine 1.0000000000 at every position because both sides ran the same graph with the same weights. That measures GPU/CPU kernel equivalence, not model correctness. Model correctness requires llama.cpp ground truth, which is what this certificate adds.

build.note: Zero compiler diagnostics; 210 eliminated this session.

what_this_does_not_mean: It does not mean the three fixes were wrong. They were real defects with measured before/after evidence.
It does not identify the remaining defect. That requires the first-divergence localisation described below.

next_step.method: First-divergence localisation against llama.cpp ground truth. Compare, in execution order and per block: attn_norm, q, kv_latent, k_nope, v, rope-adjusted q/k, scores, softmax, attention output, attn_proj, ffn_norm, gate/up, swiglu, ffn_out, resid. The FIRST tensor whose cosine falls below tolerance is the defect; fix only that.
next_step.why: Four defects have now been found by exactly this method (measure a tensor, find the one that is wrong, fix only it).
